notes.title: BUGFIX UDPATE 3 IS OUT! Auto-Fire is faster now!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
We've just put up the third update for Cally's Caves 4, and this makes a really big change to the game.  We have been receiving a lot of feedback that the autofire is too slow to be useful, which leads to more button-mashing.  We have made the autofire about 25% faster in this update, as we didn't intend for the game to be quite that mashy.  Please let us know if you think it's better, we are constantly reading all of the feedback in the steam community, and we will do everything we can to make sure everyone has a good experience with Cally's Caves 4.
Other changes:
 - took practice bots out of survival mode until we can fix the issue where their deaths dont register and survival mode gets stuck
 - fixed issue where herbert's warp room would sometimes start bugged, with no Cally in the room

Until next time, we hope you are having fun!
Jordan
